dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: So many books... Let's see here... Hah! Get a load of this one!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: This story's about a mercenary whose only skill is that he's an exceptional liar. He goes and gets himself hired by three different employers, all of which are mutual enemies...

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: And so, he's forced to spin ever more ludicrous lies to keep himself alive and keep the Mora rolling in... Hahaha, you know what? I'll read on — this looks pretty fun.
